baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun جِمَٰلَتٌ at word 2 is qualified by صُفْرٌ at word 3 inside a كأنّه simile.
baseline_models.mechanism: The camel-collective branch supplies a herd rather than one animal, the great-build branch enlarges its members, and the color branch makes the forms yellow, pallid, or dark with yellow suffusion.

activation_trace.role: Collected camels supply the plural herd and its animal silhouettes.
Great bodily build makes each camel-like figure massive rather than ordinary-sized.
Yellowness and yellow suffusion provide the herd's visible coloration.

changed_reading.before: A generic comparison to yellow camels.
changed_reading.after: A densely collected herd of huge yellow or soot-yellow camel bodies.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جِمَٰلَتٌ can remain attached to the focus root while activating its thick-rope and gathered-cable branch; صُفْرٌ still modifies the visible forms.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can describe multiple gathered ship-cables or bridge ropes whose thickness and collective arrangement, rather than animal identity, drive the likeness.

activation_trace.role: Thick rope and gathered ship-cables supply bundled, heavy strand morphology.
Yellow or dark-yellow coloration marks the cable-like forms.

changed_reading.after: A cluster of thick yellowed or smoke-dark cables.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun carries the ج م ل branch of collecting scattered parts into an undetailed whole, while صُفْرٌ supplies color.
baseline_models.mechanism: The simile may operate at the level of perceptual grouping: many visible pieces become several compact, unitemized masses.

activation_trace.role: The collected, undetailed whole supplies aggregation without requiring an animal outline.
Yellowness makes the aggregated masses visually coherent.

changed_reading.after: Several yellowed composite masses perceived as collected wholes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جِمَٰلَتٌ is tested against the focus inventory's rendered-fat branch, with صُفْرٌ providing the molten material's color.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can momentarily image multiple yellow globs of melted grease or drippings rather than solid bodies.

activation_trace.role: Rendered fat and melted grease supply viscous droplet material.
Yellowness supplies the luminous fat-like hue.

changed_reading.after: Yellow molten globs or rendered drippings.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The great-bodied ج م ل branch combines with the ص ف ر branch of emptiness and depletion at the two focus words.
baseline_models.mechanism: Visible bulk and internal lack coexist: the forms can be imposing envelopes whose apparent fullness conceals hollowness or exhaustion.

activation_trace.role: Great bodily build supplies the imposing exterior volume.
Emptiness and depletion make the large forms hollow or functionally vacant.

changed_reading.before: Large forms whose adjective only names color.
changed_reading.after: Large but emptied hulks, with color no longer the adjective's only live force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate antecedent turns the camel collective into a kinetic image. Sending or throwing identifies propulsion, flying sparks identify the emitted matter, and an enclosed building supplies monumental scale; the huge camel bodies are therefore successive projectiles, not a resting herd.

activation_trace.role: The camel collective supplies multiple animate-looking projectile silhouettes.
Great bodily build converts each silhouette into a massive airborne body.
Yellow suffusion marks the hot moving bodies.
Sending and throwing supply the outward ballistic arrow.
Flying fire-sparks identify the thrown matter as incandescent particles.
The enclosed building image gives the particles architectural bulk before the camel comparison animates them.

structural_cues: 77:32 immediately precedes the focus and supplies the thrown sparks to which the focus simile can attach.
The consecutive comparisons كالقصر and كأنه جملت layer architectural scale and animate morphology.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: thrown sparks and a building comparison immediately precede massive camel branches. Reader arrow: I carry propulsion and scale into the focus silhouettes. Live alternative: the two comparisons may simply be separate conventional likenesses without a shared kinetic model.

changed_reading.before: A stationary herd of large yellow camels.
changed_reading.after: Building-scale yellow spark masses launched in succession like airborne camel bodies.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dispatch, connected mane-like succession, following one after another, released camels, and final throwing form a temporal chain. The focus herd becomes a convoy or train of camel-shaped sparks, each cresting behind another.

activation_trace.role: Collected camels provide the convoy's repeated animal units.
Yellow suffusion keeps the successive units visibly linked.
Dispatch and emission initiate the surah's repeated outward motion.
Connected succession like hair along a mane supplies a crested serial contour.
Following in succession supplies one body arriving behind another.
Camels released toward pasture or water directly activates a moving herd rather than a penned one.
Throwing converts the surah-wide succession into the sparks' immediate launch sequence.

structural_cues: The opening oath advances through repeated feminine participles and emphatic cognate accusatives.
The repeated imperative انطلقوا in 77:29-30 leads directly into the flame and spark description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: several roots supply dispatch, serial following, released camels, and throwing. Reader arrow: I transfer that temporal cadence to the plural focus image. Live alternative: the opening agents, former peoples, addressees, and sparks may remain unrelated movers.

changed_reading.before: A single simultaneous view of a camel herd.
changed_reading.after: A dispatched train of yellow camel-like sparks cresting and following one another.

context_deltas.mechanism: An overhead canopy divides into projecting branches and is penetrated by tongues of flame. Those supplied contours activate ج م ل as gathered heavy cables: a branching rig of thick smoke-and-flame strands whose ends break into the focus forms.

activation_trace.role: Gathered ship-cables supply thick bundled strands for the branching contour.
Yellow or smoke-dark yellow colors the cable-like strands.
An overhead canopy supplies the suspended spatial frame.
A projecting branch or tip supplies bifurcation from the suspended frame.
Tongues of flame provide luminous strands within the dark branching canopy.

structural_cues: 77:30-33 is one uninterrupted spatial sequence: branching shade, flame, thrown sparks, then the focus likeness.
The three branches establish repeated strand geometry before جِمَٰلَتٌ appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an overhead three-branched structure, flame tongues, and gathered cable imagery. Reader arrow: I map the branches and tongues onto heavy cable-like contours. Live alternative: the shade may be smoke while جملت remains wholly zoological.

changed_reading.before: A freestanding bundle of yellow ropes.
changed_reading.after: Heavy yellow-black cable forms branching through an overhead smoke-and-flame canopy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah sequence repeatedly blasts, spreads, separates, lofts, branches, and finally gathers. Against that sequence, ج م ل as an undetailed total names a transient perceptual event: scattered sparks briefly cohere into camel- or cable-sized wholes before dispersing again.

activation_trace.role: The collected undetailed whole supplies the momentary reassembly of many particles.
Shared yellow luminosity lets dispersed particles read as one aggregate.
A severe wind that scatters things supplies the first dispersive force.
Opening, spreading, and branching extend the scattered field.
Separation into parts makes discreteness an explicit stage.
Flying or lofted debris supplies particulate matter in motion.
Branching and dispersal repeat the split immediately before the sparks.
Gathering what was dispersed supplies the inverse operation and confirms the collect-separate cycle.

structural_cues: The opening roots occur in the packet order blast, spread, and separate.
The focus lies between immediate branching and the later juxtaposition of separation with gathering in 77:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a repeated disperse/branch/gather sequence and a focus branch meaning collected total. Reader arrow: I treat the simile as the eye's temporary re-collection of sparks. Live alternative: these operations may organize separate eschatological scenes without selecting the focus branch.

changed_reading.after: Dispersed sparks repeatedly assemble in perception into brief yellow camel- or cable-sized wholes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The flame supplies heat and the spark inventory unexpectedly supplies fatty roast drippings. That context branch directly meets the focus branch of rendered fat, turning جملت صفر into luminous yellow molten drops flung from the fire.

activation_trace.role: Rendered fat and melted grease supply the droplets' viscous material.
Yellowness supplies a hot luminous sheen.
The tongue and ignition of fire provide the melting heat source.
Fat dripping from roast meat supplies a direct material bridge from sparks to molten grease.

structural_cues: Flame in 77:31 and sparks in 77:32 immediately precede the focus material comparison.
The verb ترمي makes the compared units ejecta rather than a continuous pool.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: flame, sparks with a fatty-dripping branch, and focus rendered-fat imagery. Reader arrow: I identify the branch overlap as a material analogy for glowing ejecta. Live alternative: the fatty sense of شرر may be lexically remote here and the camel reading may remain primary.

changed_reading.after: Large luminous globs of yellow rendered matter thrown from the flame.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night-like shade and dusk-darkness surround the flame. Because the focus color branch explicitly allows dark color suffused with yellow, صُفْرٌ becomes a composite optical state: soot-black surfaces carrying yellow or copper firelight.

activation_trace.role: Camel collectives provide broad moving surfaces on which the mixed color appears.
Yellowing, including darkness infused with yellow, licenses a smoke-black/yellow composite.
Night-like darkness supplies the soot-dark field.
Flame tongues supply yellow illumination within the dark field.
Dusk and mixed darkness reinforce an intermediate, not pure, color value.

structural_cues: The focus color follows a sequence of shade, flame, and spark.
Dark cover and luminous ejecta occupy the same immediate scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: darkness branches, flame, and a focus color scope that includes yellow-suffused dark color. Reader arrow: I combine them into one soot-and-fire appearance. Live alternative: صُفْرٌ may denote straightforward yellow without importing the darker branch scopes.

changed_reading.after: Smoke-black forms shot through with yellow, brass, or copper firelight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate shade has the exterior of shelter but no sufficiency, while the later shade belongs with actual protection. This contrast activates ص ف ر as lack: the focus's huge forms become visually full but functionally empty emblems of a shelter that cannot shelter.

activation_trace.role: Great bodily build supplies an imposing exterior that promises capacity.
Emptiness and lack remove efficacy from the imposing forms.
The shade-cover image supplies the apparent sheltering exterior.
Sufficiency is explicitly negated in the source phrase, making the cover functionally useless.
Actual warding of harm supplies the later contrast class for genuine shelter.

structural_cues: 77:30-31 names shade and then immediately denies both shading and sufficiency against flame.
77:41 returns to shade in the setting of those who ward off harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: false shade, negated sufficiency, later protection, and a focus emptiness branch. Reader arrow: I transfer functional lack into صُفْرٌ and read the large forms as hollow emblems. Live alternative: the protection contrast may be thematic while صُفْرٌ remains purely chromatic.

changed_reading.before: Large colored forms with no functional implication.
changed_reading.after: Imposing but empty forms that expose the false shelter's zero protective value.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first supplies elevated solid mountains, turns them into flying debris, later recalls fixed lofty mountains, and finally compares sparks to an enclosed building. The great-bodied focus branch converts that collapsed solidity into mobile monumental bodies: architecture and mountain mass acquire camel-like motion.

activation_trace.role: Great bodily build gives the moving forms monumental physical scale.
Yellow suffusion makes the monumental fragments incandescent.
Elevated solid aggregation supplies the original monumental mass.
Flying debris transforms fixed solidity into airborne matter.
Fixity and rootedness establish the stable state that the airborne image reverses.
Mountain height supplies vertical grandeur before the reversal into projectiles.
The enclosed building image transfers architectural scale directly to the sparks.

structural_cues: 77:10 destroys mountains, while 77:27 restates fixed lofty mountains before the fire scene.
77:32-33 moves in one step from building-scale sparks to camel-bodied forms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: fixed and lofted mountain mass, flying debris, a building comparison, and great-bodied focus imagery. Reader arrow: I read the focus as the animation of formerly stable monumentality. Live alternative: the mountain and fire scenes may offer independent scale images rather than a reversal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Oversized but still ordinary animal forms.
changed_reading.after: Incandescent monuments in flight, with mountain and building mass moving as camel-shaped bodies.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because صُفْرٌ is adjective-shaped and جِمَٰلَتٌ most readily supports animals or cables, yet the packet explicitly anchors copper/brass at ص ف ر and collected wholes at ج م ل while the immediate scene supplies flame and flying sparks. Downstream prose should present it only as a material overlay, not as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: صُفْرٌ activates copper or brass at word 3, and جِمَٰلَتٌ activates collected masses at word 2.

activation_trace.role: Collected undetailed wholes supply slag-like aggregate masses.
Copper or brass supplies a metallic rather than merely chromatic material.
Flame supplies the heat that makes the metal-like masses incandescent.
Flying sparks supply the ejection of glowing metallic fragments.

changed_reading.after: Aggregated brass or copper slag masses flung incandescent from the fire.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The outlier is acoustic even though the focus is overtly visual, but it remains anchored in the packet's whistling branch of ص ف ر and camel collective of ج م ل, with throwing and fiery running supplying motion. Downstream prose should mark it as a possible sound-image accompanying the visual convoy, not claim that the ayah explicitly states a whistle.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The whistling branch attaches to صُفْرٌ and the herd branch attaches to جِمَٰلَتٌ in the focus phrase.

activation_trace.role: The camel collective supplies a convoy of repeated moving bodies.
Whistling supplies a piercing acoustic edge to the moving forms.
Fiery running that raises dust supplies rushing motion and an implied turbulent medium.
Throwing supplies rapid passage through that medium.

changed_reading.after: A rushing camel-like convoy of sparks with a possible whistling acoustic wake.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is form-distant because جِمَٰلَتٌ is not an abstract beauty noun, but the shared focus root explicitly carries beauty in form or action and the later محسنين branch restates goodness against ugliness. It remains a valid evaluative resonance; downstream prose should call it an ironic beauty-reversal, never the primary denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The beauty branch attaches directly to the root of جِمَٰلَتٌ, while صُفْرٌ supplies the fire-lit appearance.

activation_trace.role: Beauty and graceful goodness in form supply an aesthetic value that can be inverted by the punitive scene.
Yellow or dark-yellow firelight makes the terrible forms visually compelling.
Goodness or beauty opposed to ugliness supplies the later positive pole of the contrast.

changed_reading.before: A neutral zoological or material likeness.
changed_reading.after: A terrifying counterfeit of beauty: formally striking fire-shapes opposed to the later good-doers.

strongest_changes: The immediate throwing, spark, and building cues convert a static camel herd into massive ballistic bodies.
The whole-surah disperse/branch/gather sequence activates ج م ل as the eye's temporary collection of particles into wholes.
The spark branch of fatty drippings directly activates the focus branch of rendered fat, preserving an unusual molten-material reading.
Shade, flame, and dusk-darkness revise صُفْرٌ from flat yellow to smoke-dark color suffused with yellow or copper light.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet did not force one disambiguation. Its motion, branching, dispersal, shelter, and scale sequences separately strengthened animal, cable, aggregate, molten, chromatic, and hollow readings while each remained anchored in the two focus roots.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact antecedent and number construal of كأنه relative to the preceding شرر remain syntactically underdetermined by the packet annotations.
Camel and cable branches are form-nearer than aggregate, rendered-fat, emptiness, copper, beauty, or sound branches, but context activation does not establish lexical selection.
Long-range disperse/gather and mountain/building mechanisms may be rhetorical organization rather than local semantic pressure.
Pure yellow, dark yellow suffusion, copper/brass, and emptiness are live but unequal activations of ص ف ر.
